Resources page: full-body standing three-quarter pose, holding an open cream paper document booklet with both hands at mid-chest, reading it attentively with eyes down, document pages have subtle unidentifiable gray lines, no readable text. Entire head, hands, objects and shoes within frame, generous 8% safe margins. Portrait 4:5 framing, clean soft photographic studio lighting, real fabric and skin. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no studio, no floor, no cast floor shadow, no gradient, no grain/noise added, no extra logos or watermark. Sharp clean silhouette for layering over CSS gradients and typography.
